events.title: Wuchang Uprising Begins the Xinhai Revolution
events.description: A military uprising by revolutionary soldiers in Wuchang, Hubei Province, broke out against the Qing dynasty. It quickly spread to other provinces, and within months the dynasty collapsed.
events.significance: The uprising led to the fall of the Qing dynasty and the end of over two thousand years of imperial rule in China, leading to the founding of the Republic of China in 1912. The date is commemorated as National Day in Taiwan, known as Double Ten Day.

events.title: Premiere of Porgy and Bess
events.description: George Gershwin's opera Porgy and Bess, with libretto by DuBose Heyward and lyrics by Ira Gershwin, premiered at the Alvin Theatre in Boston before moving to Broadway. It featured an all-Black cast of classically trained singers.
events.significance: The work became a landmark of American opera and introduced standards such as Summertime. It was a milestone for the representation of African American performers in classical music, though it also sparked debate over its portrayal of Black life.

events.title: Spiro Agnew Resigns as Vice President
events.description: Spiro T. Agnew resigned as Vice President of the United States and pleaded no contest to a charge of federal income tax evasion, as part of a plea bargain related to a corruption investigation involving bribes taken while he was Maryland's governor.
events.significance: Agnew was the second vice president in U.S. history to resign. His departure led to Gerald Ford's appointment under the 25th Amendment, which set the stage for Ford's presidency after Nixon resigned in 1974.

events.title: Birth of Giuseppe Verdi
events.description: Giuseppe Verdi, one of the greatest Italian opera composers, was born in Le Roncole, near Busseto, in the Duchy of Parma.
events.significance: Verdi composed enduring operas including Rigoletto, La Traviata, Aida, and Otello. His music became closely associated with the Italian unification movement, and his works remain central to the operatic repertoire worldwide.

events.title: Egyptian Airliner Interception Incident (Achille Lauro Affair)
events.description: U.S. Navy F-14 fighter jets intercepted an Egyptian aircraft carrying the hijackers of the cruise ship Achille Lauro and forced it to land at a NATO base in Sigonella, Sicily.
events.significance: The incident caused a diplomatic standoff between the United States and Italy over jurisdiction and heightened tensions over counterterrorism policy during the 1980s.
